title: I Declare A Thumb War!
description:
Verse a non player in a thumb war!
Anyone can win.

Film your battle if possible! (The Summer Clause: You gain a bonus band if you arm wrestle a cop)

title: Spotto!
description: It's spotto time!\nTake photos of 5 yellow items of clothing.

title: Moto-Selfie
description: Take a selfie with a motorcycle or moped.

title: Statue Selfie!
description: Take a selfie with a statue while posing like the statue.

title: 60-Second Laugh...
description: You must laugh continuously for 60 seconds out loud. You receive an extra band for every non-player that starts laughing.

title: Nutbush Dance-Off!
description: Do the nutbush for 1 minute. You receive 1 bonus band for every non-player that joins.

title: Staring Contest
description: Challenge a non player to a staring contest. Anyone can win.

title: It's Time For Show and Tell!
description: Time for show and tell...it's been a while right?\nFind a non-player and do a show and tell of something you're carrying with you right now.

title: Signature Handshake
description: Make a handshake up with a team mate that has at least 6 steps. Film it. Each player gets a band.

title: Dap Clap Capture
description: Dap up a non player.\n\nYou must film the dap (with their permission of course) to receive a band.

title: Straw Rush
description:
Collect drinking straws from different locations. You have 3 minutes from now to find the first straw.

The timer resets to 3 minutes every time you find another straw.

The challenge is over when your timer ends. The challenge is vetoed if you find no straws.

You receive 1 band per straw.

Your time starts now!

title: Napkin Rush
description:
Collect napkins from different locations. You have 2 minutes from now to find the first napkin.

The timer resets to 2 minutes every time you find another napkin.

The challenge is over when your timer ends. The challenge is vetoed if you find no napkins.

You receive 1 band per napkin.

Your time starts now!

title: Pet That Dawg?!
description:
Ask a non-player: 
 "Can I pet that dawg?"

You must film yourself only - not them.

title: Where's The Fire?!
description: Take a photo of a fire hose. It must be of the hose itself and not just the signage for it.

title: I'm Telling You Man... Every Third Blink Is Slower...
description: Walk to the nearest traffic light. Do star jumps for a full cycle of the traffic lights - until every light has been red at least once.

title: Photo With The Fuzz
description: Take a selfie with a Police Officer / Security Guard / Mall Cop. They must consent of course.

title: Bird Selfie
description:
You get 1 attempt to take a selfie. You receive 1 band for each bird visible in the photo.

The challenge is vetoed if you fail to get a single bird in the photo.

You have 3 minutes. Your time starts now.

title: Street Performer
description: Perform a dramatic reading of a food menu /sign or public notice for 30 seconds.

title: High Five!
description: Collect 2 high-fives from 2 different non-players. You receive one band.

title: Spot The Year
description: Find the oldest year written on a plaque/building/sign/monument. Take a photo.

title: Human Compass
description: Ask a non-player to point north without using their phone. You get one band regardless of if they're correct.

title: Shadow Hunters
description: Capture a photo containing shadows from at least 3 different objects.

title: Public Wi-Fi Quest
description: Find a venue advertising free Wi-Fi. Take a photo of the advertisement.

title: Pop Quiz!
description: Name 20 countries. Film the attempt.

title: Bench Olympics
description: Perform 20 step-ups using a public bench or low ledge. Film the attempt. You have 30 seconds. Your time starts now.

title: The Local Expert
description: Ask a non-player for directions to somewhere within eyeshot.

title: One-Leg Wonder
description: Stand on one leg for 30 seconds. A teammate must provide dramatic sports commentary and film it.

title: Impatient and Oblivious
description: Go to a set of traffic lights and start pushing the button for the pedestrian crossing. Keep going even after the green man appears/ until it has become red again.

title: Twinning!
description: Find an object that matches a teammate's shirt's colour. Photograph them together.

title: Window Shopper
description: Find something in a shop window for sale that's worth at least $1000. Photograph it.

title: The Human Letter
description: Use a teammate or teammates to form an uppercase version of the first letter of your team colour. Everyone who participates gets a band.

title: Landmark Salesperson
description: Give a 20-second sales pitch for a nearby building or statue. Film it.

title: Synthetic Shadow Selfie
description: Take a selfie with only your shadow in it. The shadow must be cast by artificial light.

title: Invisible Pet
description: Walk an invisible pet for 20 seconds. The more dramatic the better. Film your adventure.

title: The Great Sync
description: Walk in perfect step with teammates for 50 steps. Each participant gets a band.

title: The Expert
description: Speak confidently about something you know almost nothing about for 60 seconds. Film your rambling.

title: The Great Discovery Channel
description: Give a 60 second narration on an everyday object as if it was just discovered by scientists. Film your discovery.

title: Speed Puzzle
description: Use objects nearby to create a smiley face in under 60 seconds. Your time starts now!

title: Heads Up
description: Balance an object on your head while walking 20 metres. Film from a selfie perspective as you walk.

title: Boss Battle
description: Race teammate to the end of the block.

title: One Breath Story
description: Tell a complete story using only a single breath. Film your story.

title: The 'Um' challenge
description: Speak for 1 minute on any topic without saying 'um' or 'ah' or any of the like. Film your attempt.

title: Leaf Collector
description: Find and photograph a leaf that's still attached to a tree that is not green.

title: ATM Hunter
description: Find an ATM and take a selfie with it.

title: Busker Hunter
description: Take a video of a street performer in action.

title: Graffiti Detective
description: Make a 60 second video attempting to decipher some graffiti.

title: David Urbanborough
description: Film a 30 second David Attenborough style commentary video for any inanimate object that is moving such as a car/tram/etc.

title: The Great Debate
description: Debate with a non-player or a teammate whether a hotdog is a sandwich. Film it for 60 seconds if possible. Each player gets a band.

title: Hydrant Hero
description: Make your way to the nearest fire hydrant and take a selfie with it.

title: Platform Pursuit
description: Make your way to a railway station and take a photo with the station sign visible.

title: Cheapskate
description: Find the most expensive item on a menu. Take a photo of your finger pointing to it.

title: Alphabet Soup
description: Recite the alphabet backwards and film it
